# video48 - L1 (Proxy) reconstruction, Three.js sampled-frame baseline

Representation: L1 proxy. Three.js sampled-frame baseline (not a Blender-protocol reproduction).

Observed (24 reference samples): a single red/blue costumed hero web-swings forward along a city street canyon on an overcast day, followed by a third-person chase camera that keeps him near image centre. Phases seen: swinging down the street past a dark glass tower on the left (0-3 s), release and launch upward with the camera looking up at the sky (3.5-4.7 s), a head-first dive with the camera looking steeply down at the street (5.3-7.0 s), pull-out into a swing in a street with a yellow/blue "W" billboard on the left and a purple sign further on, with a skybridge far ahead (7.6-8.8 s), a high flip/inverted fall above the rooftops with a river on the left horizon (9.4-10.6 s), then another dive and swing that revisits the same billboards and skybridge (11.1-13.5 s).

Geometry: instanced box buildings on a seeded city grid (main street facades at x=+-9 m), landmark dark tower with antenna, skybridge box, flat billboard planes, sphere trees, box cars, road/ground/water planes, gradient sky dome and fog. Hero: articulated proxy (torso, pelvis, head sphere, two-segment arms and legs with shoulder/elbow/hip/knee joints) with pose presets (reach, vee, hang, spread, dive, split, invert, tuck) blended over time and whole-body pitch/roll for flips and dives. Web: a thin cylinder from the right hand to a fixed world anchor during swing intervals.

Camera/timing: camera height, pitch, yaw and forward progress are keyframed at the sample timestamps (monotone cubic interpolation); hero placement is derived from his observed screen position and an estimated depth at each sample. Inference: the reappearance of the same billboards/skybridge/storefronts suggests a hard cut at ~10.85 s back to the earlier street position (exact cut time is unobserved, between samples at 10.56 and 11.14 s). Speeds, depths, fov (58 deg) and building layout are estimates.

Feedback: none received yet (initial round). Unverified: all framing, sizes and timing between samples.

rounds.reason: Rescaled street canyon and building heights, raised camera in overhead phases, corrected steep upward view and lateral camera offsets.
